question.text:
The curve C has equation

    y = -10*sqrt(x) + x**2 + 15,    x ≥ 0.

The point P(4, 11) lies on C and l is the tangent to C at P.

(a) Show that the tangent l to C at P has equation y = 11*(x/2 - 1).

(b) The finite region R is bounded by the y-axis, the curve C, the tangent l and the x-axis. Find the exact area of R.
